description: In the ordinary-world following Return Threshold crossing, Francisco enters the post-integration phase where Record Keepers weaponize the natural contentment-satisfaction from transformation-achievement as a curiosity-destroyer designed to create knowledge-stagnation that wastes cosmic-wisdom. The ordinary-space reveals brutal truth: contentment creates comfort that kills curiosity; without question-asking, integration becomes stagnation rather than extension. The antagonist adaptation maximizes satisfaction-temptation—cosmic-transformation complete, contentment achieved, rest deserved—while growth-continuation demands insatiable-inquiry. Francisco discovers Grazer's curiosity-driven-discovery principles encoded in ordinary-integration mechanics: breakthrough-insight emerges not from answer-possession but from question-generation that drives continuous-exploration. The cosmic-return demonstrates this perfectly—transformation provides answers creating contentment, but ordinary-world application requires new-questions about implementation, adaptation, sustainability. He must practice curiosity-protocol where achievement-satisfaction triggers question-asking rather than replacing it: How does cosmic-wisdom apply to ordinary-challenges? What gaps remain? What new problems emerge? The choice: accept comfortable-satisfaction that creates knowledge-stagnation (which wastes transformation), or cultivate insatiable-curiosity through questioning (which extends cosmic-growth into ordinary-realm). He chooses curiosity-practice, establishing question-protocol that transforms contentment-achievement into inquiry-springboard, extending cosmic-transformation through continuous-discovery in mundane-world.
